shared_elements: animal figure in profile on a vertical/sloping surface
comb-like or repeated short strokes (fringe of legs/fingers)
justification: Both surfaces carry carved animal-like figures rendered schematically, and both include a repeated fringe of short strokes reading as multiple limbs or digits, but that is a very generic correspondence. A shows multiple crescent-hulled, many-oared boat-like or centipede-like linear motifs stacked in registers, whereas B shows a single small quadruped in high relief crawling head-down on a pillar above an arm-and-hand motif — different subjects, different relationships and different relief conventions.
